intent.reason_now: A founder preparing launch materials may need to record a product walkthrough.

raw_plan.promise: Screen Studio lets a Mac-based founder record a product walkthrough, apply cursor effects after recording, and export the result at up to 4K and 60 fps.

events.body:
If you’re creating a launch or feature demo on a Mac, record the walkthrough in Screen Studio, then refine how the cursor appears after you finish recording.

Screen Studio is screen recording software built only for macOS. It records precise mouse-movement data separately from the screen, synchronizes it with the video, and adds the cursor back into the final result.

Because the cursor is not baked into the capture, you can smooth its movement or change its size and shape afterward. You can improve how viewers follow your product without recording the walkthrough again.

When the video is ready, export it at up to 4K and 60 fps. That export option is included in every Screen Studio plan.

The Mac download gives you the application needed to record one walkthrough and try the cursor workflow for yourself.

events.subject: Keep your cursor editable
events.preview_text: Adjust cursor effects after recording, then export up to 4K at 60 fps.
events.body:
Record your product walkthrough before every cursor decision is final. With Screen Studio, you can capture it on a Mac and refine the cursor afterward.

Screen Studio is screen recording software for macOS. It records synchronized mouse-movement data separately from the screen, then adds the cursor back into the finished video.

This lets you smooth its movement or change its size and shape after recording. Viewers can follow your product more clearly without another capture.

Every plan includes export up to 4K at 60 fps. The Monthly plan is $29/month, while the Yearly plan is $9/month, billed annually. Both include all Screen Studio features.
